firmware.result: Pinned ESP-IDF 5.5.3 Console OS build and exact artifact verifier passed; USB-A host off, C6 radio disabled

rtc_host.coverage: Every calendar day 2000-2099, one-hot weekday, 2038 and range boundaries; invalid dates, all six I2C failure points, VLF preservation/clear and ignored/corrupt readback

usb_clock_host.coverage: Bounded framing, fragmented/coalesced input, noise, partial timeout, duplicate-write prevention, invalid time/CRC, busy/unavailable RTC

python_clock.coverage: UTC encoding, CRC/nonce/reserved validation, read-only asynchronous-probe wait and actual probe-error reporting

post_build_client_fix.reason: After the firmware build, read-only status was made to wait for the asynchronous RTC probe, like sync already did; firmware bytes are unchanged. The authorization preserves the exact build-time client hash.

hardware_limits: Warm USB restarts are verified; full power-off retention and long-term clock accuracy are untested.
Battery pack presence/capacity and motion calibration remain unverified; invalid 2S voltage does not produce a percentage.
Physical Control Panel interaction, sustained scrolling, game/Doom quit-relaunch and B speaker at nonzero volume still need acceptance.
A startup/Doom audio was operator-confirmed on the earlier speaker repair; serial playback markers alone do not prove current acoustic quality.
C6 radio, USB-A host, camera/microphone and charger controls remain outside this installed candidate.
